# Kaizen Web

> We build and improve business websites. We also help owners get software projects back on track.

**Website:** https://kaizenweb.co.uk
**Contact:** hello@kaizenweb.co.uk
**Areas:** Merseyside and West Yorkshire, United Kingdom. We travel to clients; there is no office open to visitors.
**Last checked:** 2 October 2026

## Services and useful pages

- [Web design for businesses](https://kaizenweb.co.uk/): fast, clear websites that help customers get in touch.
- [WordPress web design](https://kaizenweb.co.uk/services/wordpress-web-design/): improve an existing site, rebuild it or start fresh. Includes phone and site-change guidance.
- [Contract product owner](https://kaizenweb.co.uk/contract-product-owner/): help set priorities and move a software project forward.
- [Free website speed check](https://kaizenweb.co.uk/performance-scanner/): see your score first. Below 90, email is required for the full report. The PDF downloads in your browser.
- [Our work](https://kaizenweb.co.uk/case-studies/): websites built for real businesses.
- [Midland Oil Group](https://kaizenweb.co.uk/case-studies/midland-oil-group/): clearer product pages and an oil finder, with approved load-time and enquiry results.
- [Helen Moore Hairdressing](https://kaizenweb.co.uk/case-studies/helen-moore-hairdressing/): a salon website with a clear route to booking.
- [About Kaizen](https://kaizenweb.co.uk/about/): how we work.
- [Our pledge](https://kaizenweb.co.uk/pledge/): what to expect from the work and price.
- [Contact](https://kaizenweb.co.uk/contact/): start with a free first conversation. Work begins after the agreed non-refundable deposit.
- [Website guides](https://kaizenweb.co.uk/blog/): choosing, improving and looking after a business website.
